data.body: DEFECTS INTRODUCED BY THIS SESSION AND CORRECTED. (a) The enumerator was widened to hand non-mini arms a fresh tag before the runners could write one; a gstack dispatch for unit .r3b ran as --rep 3 and wrote 7 artifacts to the burned .r3 path. Killed mid-run and archived under wave3/quarantine/killed-variant-dispatch-2026-09-18/ with a README; not deleted, since it was partly paid for. This is the same defect class the original refusal existed to prevent, committed by the change meant to close it. (b) The instrument-failure reclassification was keyed on the unit rather than on the specific historical record, so it swallowed every void at that key including later legitimate ones; affected units read 'claimed' permanently and the reconciler re-voided them each pass, appending 8 spurious void rows before it was noticed. Now pinned to five exact (arm, run, replicate, target, timestamp) records. The spurious rows remain in the append-only ledger. (c) Three separate analyses were reported from misread return shapes before being checked -- independence() returns a 2-tuple of (checks, records); merged-ballot provenance is a dict, not a list. One produced a false '61/61 clean' independence figure; the true figure was unchanged at 50 of 61.
